Usage: moon ide <command> [<args>]

Semantic IDE tooling for MoonBit codebases. Run inside a MoonBit module or
workspace to use compiler-aware navigation instead of text search.

Choose a command by intent:
  peek-def          resolve definitions and show source context
  find-references   find usages of a symbol across dependents
  rename            compute semantic rename edits; use --apply to rewrite files
  hover             show type and docs at a source position
  outline           summarize the structure of a file or package
  analyze           report public API usage counts
  doc               search exported APIs and documentation
  workspace-symbols search top-level symbols in the current workspace
  codelens           show local and global reference CodeLens entries
  gen-symbols       write ./symbols.jsonl for the current package

Common argument forms:
  symbol/query      foo | @pkg.foo | Type::member | @pkg.Type::member
  --loc             path[:line[:col]]  (1-based; line required for hover)

Examples:
  moon ide peek-def Array::length
  moon ide peek-def --loc ./main.mbt:8:7 --json
  moon ide find-references println --loc ./main.mbt:12
  moon ide find-references --loc ./main.mbt:12:5 --json
  moon ide hover map --loc ./main.mbt:8:7
  moon ide hover --loc ./main.mbt:8:7 --json
  moon ide rename old_name new_name --loc ./lib.mbt:23
  moon ide rename old_name new_name --loc ./lib.mbt:23 --apply
  moon ide doc '@json'
  moon ide workspace-symbols 'String' --json
  moon ide codelens ./main.mbt

See 'moon ide <command> -h' for command-specific details.
